info.title: Market Intelligence API
info.description: Pay-per-call market intelligence for AI agents, built on observed data. On-chain order flow from executed DEX trades on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, Robinhood Chain and Solana (buy/sell pressure, momentum, anomalies vs each asset's own baseline, large trades, smart-money wallets, candles and daily datasets); token risk checks and swap quotes; Hyperliquid perps funding, open interest and crowding; SEC EDGAR (XBRL fundamentals, Form 4, Form 144, 13D/13G, dividends, fails-to-deliver, 8-K) and European ESEF fundamentals; European short interest (AMF); ECB, Eurostat, US Treasury and Federal Reserve data; CFTC positioning, EIA oil inventories and the official macro calendar; GDELT and SEC news; and deterministic analytics primitives on numbers you supply. Every answer is timestamped and names its source. Decisions (/api/v1/decision*) are a rule-based aggregation of these data with a free, live track record (/api/v1/decision/track-record). The chain query parameter of the token routes names the chain the token lives on; it is never the payment network, which every paid route lists in x-payment-info.networks as CAIP-2 ids.
info.x-guidance: Every paid route answers HTTP 402 with x402 payment requirements (USDC on Base, Polygon, Arbitrum, World Chain or Solana; EURC on Base or World Chain); pay and repeat the request. You are charged only on HTTP 2xx: an unknown symbol is a free 404. Start with GET /api/v1/intelligence/{symbol} (live on-chain order flow of one asset), GET /api/v1/intelligence/summary (what is moving), GET /api/v1/intelligence/token-risk/{address} (before buying a token) or GET /api/v1/report/{symbol} (filings, flow and news of one stock). Free: /coverage (which symbols and sources exist), /api/v1/datasets, /status (data freshness), /api/v1/decision/track-record (measured hit rates). A signal of INSUFFICIENT_DATA means too few trades in the window. Full guide: /llms.txt.

get.summary: Check a token for honeypot, admin and holder risks
get.description: Use before buying any token: ERC-20 on Base (default), Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism or Polygon, or any SPL/Token-2022 mint on Solana (chain=solana; a base58 address is detected automatically). Simulates a sell by a real recent buyer and a buy from the main pool with eth_call (honeypot check), reads the owner and EIP-1967 proxy, scans the bytecode for mint, blacklist, pause, fee, limit and trading-switch functions, measures liquidity in Uniswap v2/v3 and Aerodrome pools, the share of burned LP tokens and the buy tax observed in recent buys, adds the last hour of trade flow, and returns a verdict (LOW_RISK, CAUTION, HIGH_RISK) with a 0-100 safety score and every check (PASS, WARN, FAIL, UNKNOWN, INFO). Automated checks, not an audit. Cached 120 s. On Solana: mint and freeze authority, Token-2022 extensions (transfer fee, permanent delegate, transfer hook, default-frozen accounts, pause), metadata name and symbol, and the share of the 10 largest wallets with pools and vaults (program-derived owners) counted apart; sell simulation and pool liquidity are not checked there (listed in notChecked). Uniswap v4 pools created while the new-token watcher runs (Base, Ethereum) are included: in-range depth from StateView, simulations through the PoolManager and the hook's swap powers.

get.summary: Token price by contract address, live from the chain
get.description: USD price of any ERC-20 token on Base (default), Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism or Polygon, read from the chain: a simulated $100 USDC buy on the best route (Uniswap v2/v3/v4, Aerodrome, direct or through WETH) and the simulated sale of the tokens it returns, both with eth_call at the latest block. priceUsd is the geometric mean of buyPriceUsd and sellPriceUsd, so pool fees cancel; roundTripCostPercent is the loss of that $100 round trip (fees, spread, impact, any transfer tax) and works as a liquidity gauge; canSellBack is false when the sale finds no route. totalSupply and fullyDilutedValueUsd (supply x price) come from the token contract. Works for tokens too new for price APIs. A token no route can price is a free 404. Cached 15 s.
